description: This is a C# source code file defining an ASP.NET Core MVC controller named AdminController for managing media files within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes actions for listing, uploading, moving, deleting media files and folders, and handling media options.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Controller for managing media files and folders in OrchardCore CMS, providing actions for CRUD operations, uploads, and media options.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the main view for media management after authorization check.

methods.name: GetFolders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of media folders within a specified path, with authorization and permission checks.

methods.name: GetMediaItems
methods.description: Retrieves media files within a specified folder, filtered by extensions, with authorization.

methods.name: GetMediaItem
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific media file if authorized.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Handles media file uploads with size limit and authorization.

methods.name: ProcessMediaUploadAsync
methods.description: Processes uploaded media files, validating extensions, saving files, and handling errors.

methods.name: DeleteFolder
methods.description: Deletes a specified media folder after authorization.

methods.name: DeleteMedia
methods.description: Deletes a specified media file after authorization.

methods.name: MoveMedia
methods.description: Moves/renames a media file, with extension validation and cache update.

methods.name: DeleteMediaList
methods.description: Deletes multiple media files, with authorization.

methods.name: MoveMediaList
methods.description: Moves multiple media files between folders, with error handling.

methods.name: CreateFolder
methods.description: Creates a new media folder after validation and authorization.

methods.name: CreateFileResult
methods.description: Creates a result object with media file details for responses.

methods.name: MediaApplication
methods.description: Returns the media application view with permission-based options.

methods.name: Options
methods.description: Returns media options view if authorized.

methods.name: GetRequestedExtensions
methods.description: Parses and filters requested file extensions based on allowed extensions.

methods.name: GetCacheBustingMediaPublicUrl
methods.description: Generates a cache-busted public URL for media files.

methods.name: PreCacheRemoteMedia
methods.description: Preemptively caches remote media files if using remote storage.

methods.name: IsSpecialFolder
methods.description: Checks if a folder is a special system folder.
